lens_area — SEGMENTATION world op

• Data kinds: none → scalar (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lens_area(r: 'float', d: 'float') -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import segworld; segworld.lens_area(r: 'float', d: 'float') -> 'float'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("lens_area"))

Usage

Closed-form overlap (lens) area of two equal-radius-r circles at centre distance d; 0 when d >= 2r (lens_area).
